reason: This continuation plan restarts WES2 at a template implementation layer and does not clearly continue from phase 18 in a scoped way. It also proposes file inspection and implementation outside the allowed write scope, including lib/WES2_screen.dart, lib/WES2_controller.dart, lib/WES2_models.dart, lib/template_model.dart, lib/templates.dart, lib/WES2_plan_service.dart, and lib/WES2_repository.dart, none of which are in the permitted write list. The plan also introduces a new picker UI and service wiring without anchoring them to the approved WES2 file boundaries, which risks scope drift from the current phase.
required_changes: Limit the continuation plan to the allowed write scope only: lib/WES2_*.dart, lib/WES2_widgets/WES2_*.dart, test/wes2/WES2_*.dart, docs/wes2/**, .orchestrator/wes2/**, and lib/home_screen.dart only for the WES2 Quick Access card/import.

Remove any implementation steps that require modifying or depending on non-allowed files such as lib/WES2_screen.dart, lib/WES2_controller.dart, lib/WES2_models.dart, lib/template_model.dart, lib/templates.dart, lib/WES2_plan_service.dart, and lib/WES2_repository.dart unless they are actually within lib/WES2_*.dart and explicitly named accordingly.
Rewrite the plan so it continues from phase 18 without restarting WES2 architecture work; reference only the next incremental phase goals and avoid re-litigating template system foundations.

If template support is in scope for phase 18, confine changes to WES2-specific files and explicitly state how they interact with the existing WES2 architecture rather than proposing broad controller/repository refactors.
Add explicit analysis/test steps only for WES2-specific files under the allowed path set.
Cite the supporting spec section when requesting any correction in future revisions, especially §9.7 Templates, §9.8 Save workout to templates, §4.1 Duplicate exercise prevention, and §10.1 Overflow.
scope_risks: Template flow touches non-allowed files and likely exceeds the current continuation boundary.
The plan appears to depend on a WES2_screen/WES2_controller architecture that is not confirmed to be within writable scope.
Potential hidden restart of WES2 rather than a strict phase-18 continuation.
Risk of scope creep into template picker UI, service DI wiring, and persistence plumbing beyond the approved file set.
Any row-text UI work must avoid RenderFlex overflow; the plan mentions ellipsis guards but does not prove all long Row text paths are constrained.
The plan must not introduce ListTile inside PopupMenuItem; ensure any menu/picker UI follows this blocker rule.
